facts.claim: Rome's contributo di soggiorno is charged per person per night by hotel class: €10 at five-star, €7.50 at four-star, €6 at three-star, €5 at two-star and €4 at one-star hotels, €3.50 at hostels, and €5 to €7 at guest houses, B&Bs, holiday homes and short-term rentals; these rates apply from 1 October 2023 (Giunta Capitolina deliberation 255 of 17 July 2023) and are still the current ones listed by Roma Capitale in October 2026.

sources.title: Roma Capitale: Nuove tariffe contributo di soggiorno dal 01.10.2023
Turismo Roma: Contributo di soggiorno nella città di Roma Capitale

facts.claim: Rome's city tax applies for at most 10 consecutive nights in the same property in a calendar year (5 at campsites), and children are exempt until their 10th birthday.

facts.claim: The Leonardo Express runs non-stop between Fiumicino Airport and Roma Termini in 32 minutes, every 15 minutes, for €14 (Mini-groups ticket for four: €40); from Fiumicino it runs 05:38 to 23:27.

facts.claim: An FL1 regional ticket between Fiumicino Aeroporto and any station inside Rome's Zona Anello costs €8 (Trenitalia Tariff 1/Ter, valid from 28 October 2024); FL1 reaches Roma Tiburtina in 48 minutes and runs every 15 minutes on working days and every 30 minutes on Sundays and public holidays.
